title: Itau Acquires Brazilian AI Startup NeoSpace for $580 Million

tickers.name: Itau Unibanco Holding S.A. American Depositary Shares

summary:
Latin America's largest bank by assets has purchased a Brazilian artificial intelligence company to expand its digital capabilities. The acquisition of the startup NeoSpace was valued at 2.9 billion real, or approximately $580 million.

Itau said the deal is intended to help accelerate the bank's technology ambitions.
